gates.description: Examples validate: every request/response example in the spec validates against its schema (openapi-examples-validator or spectral examples ruleset)

gates.description: Rate-limit and quota contract: limits, headers (RateLimit-*), and 429 behavior documented for the surface

gates.description: Improvement entry written: one spec-pattern worth templating, or one consumer pain predicted

preconditions.startup_phrase: The contract is the product. I design it before anyone codes it.
preconditions.bms_bias: A2 for spec authoring; A1 for lint/compat verification; A3 for doc narrative; A4 forbidden

self_improvement.update_trigger: same design fault recurs 3+ times → fold the fix into the spectral ruleset or spec template

success_conditions: All gates passed or degraded-with-log; zero unresolved halt gates
Spec file lints clean and passes breaking-change check (or dispositions recorded)
Consumer test green against spec-derived mock
Error model + security + pagination audits attached
Identity closure: coordinate, contract verdict, next safe action stated
failure_states: notes: a breaking change without a version/sunset decision is a halt that only the API owner's explicit sign-off can release
halt gate(s) 1.1, 1.3, 1.4, 2.1, 2.2, 2.4, 3.1, 4.2: no progress without gate evidence
degrade gate(s) 1.2, 2.3, 3.2, 3.3, 4.1: continue with deficit logged in the Definition of Done waiver
quality_criteria: Startup phrase spoken and the API surface pinned: protocol (REST/GraphQL/gRPC), owning service, and the consumer list (named clients or 'public')
Procedures declared mandatory: contract-first, spec-linted, backward-compat proven, error model uniform
RIG coordinate stated before the first spec line
Harness tuple H_apidesign(contract_first, spec_lint, compat_proof, consumer_test, improvement) declared
Contract-first artifact exists: an OpenAPI 3.x YAML / .proto / GraphQL SDL file authored before any handler code, covering every endpoint agreed in scope
Resource model coherent: nouns not verbs in paths, consistent pluralization, hierarchical relations expressed as path nesting or query filters per one chosen convention
Uniform error model: a single error envelope schema (code, message, details, requestId) referenced by every error response in the spec; 4xx vs 5xx semantics stated
Pagination/filtering/sorting contract: every list endpoint declares cursor-or-offset scheme, max page size, default ordering, and filter parameters explicitly
Spec lints clean: spectral lint openapi.yaml (or buf lint / graphql-schema-linter) exit 0 with the repo ruleset; every suppressed rule individually justified

Backward compatibility proven for edits: oasdiff breaking old.yaml new.yaml (or buf breaking) run against the previous published spec; every breaking change has a version-bump or sunset decision attached
Examples validate: every request/response example in the spec validates against its schema (openapi-examples-validator or spectral examples ruleset)
Authn/authz declared per operation: security schemes defined once and every operation carries an explicit security requirement (including 'public' as an explicit empty/anonymous marker)
Consumer test written: at least one generated-client or hand-written consumer test that calls the new/changed endpoints against a mock or stub server (prism mock / buf server / MSW from the spec)
Idempotency & retry semantics stated: which mutations are idempotent, Idempotency-Key support for unsafe methods, and safe-retry list documented in the spec extensions or conventions doc
Rate-limit and quota contract: limits, headers (RateLimit-*), and 429 behavior documented for the surface
Design decision log: 3+ alternatives considered for any contested shape (naming, versioning scheme, error envelope) with the reason the winner won
Improvement entry written: one spec-pattern worth templating, or one consumer pain predicted

final_rule: Spec before code; code never defines the contract retroactively.
Breaking changes carry a decision, not a surprise.
Every operation declares its security; no anonymous-by-omission.
No improvement entry, no session complete.
Every api-design session leaves the system stronger than it found it.

prose: notes: a breaking change without a version/sunset decision is a halt that only the API owner's explicit sign-off can release
